code_quality.justification: 8 commits (+1,120/-12) deliver a full payments service (charge/capture, signed webhooks, refunds) with descriptive, ticket-keyed messages. Held below 9 because 6 of 8 commits are large single-author drops by Liam (up to +285) pushed straight to main with no PR merges, and the other two commits are trivial (a typo fix, a .gitignore line).

evidence_citations.reason: 'PAY-1: Add payment processing service with Stripe client wrapper' (+285) is substantial but lands as one large drop.
'PAY-2: Handle payment_intent webhooks with signature verification' (+281) ships the feature with its tests.
'Fix typo in payment config comment' (+1/-1) is Maya's only commit, a trivial change.

areas_for_improvement: Break large drops into reviewable PRs
No PR merges: everything pushed straight to main

testing.justification: Two explicit test commits add 226 test lines: tests/test_webhooks.py ships with the webhook handler, and 'PAY-1: Unit tests for charge, capture and idempotency keys' adds tests/test_service.py (+132). CI runs pytest with coverage. Gaps: the refund flow (PAY-3, +186/-9) has no tests and there is no dedicated testing ticket.

evidence_citations.reason: 'PAY-1: Unit tests for charge, capture and idempotency keys' adds tests/test_service.py (+132).
The webhook commit includes tests/test_webhooks.py (+94) alongside payments/webhooks.py.
'PAY-3: Implement refund flow and partial refunds' (+186/-9) adds no test file.

strengths: Service and webhook logic unit tested
areas_for_improvement: Add tests for refunds and partial refunds
Create a testing ticket so coverage is planned

documentation.justification: Explicit documentation commit 'Document payments API, webhook events and refund rules' adds docs/payments.md and updates README.md (+137/-2). However, Jira summaries are one- or two-word labels ('Webhooks', 'Refunds', 'CI/CD') that do not document the work, so this falls short of the 9-10 band.

collaboration.justification: Peer ratings average 2.0 (12/30). Liam receives 3s for output but poor communication ('pushed straight to main'), while Maya and Noah receive only 1s and 2s for not picking up work. All 4 tickets (21 points) are assigned to Liam and Maya and Noah hold none, which is strong evidence of freeriding.

evidence_citations.reason: 'Didn't pick up any ticket this sprint' documents a member with no assigned work.
'No PRs or stand-up updates' shows the high performer did not coordinate with the team.
Even the CI/CD ticket is Liam's; Maya and Noah are assigned 0 of 4 tickets.

strengths: Liam's delivery is acknowledged by both teammates
areas_for_improvement: Assign tickets to every member at planning
Use PRs and stand-ups so work is visible and shared

cicd.justification: 'PAY-4: Add CI pipeline (pytest + coverage), Dockerfile and staging deploy' adds .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/deploy.yml and a Dockerfile, covering automated tests, image build and deployment to staging. Minor gap: the pipeline arrives on day 9 of 12 in one commit, so most features were pushed before any automated check existed.

evidence_citations.reason: 'PAY-4: Add CI pipeline (pytest + coverage), Dockerfile and staging deploy' adds ci.yml, deploy.yml and a Dockerfile (+96).

'PAY-1: Add payment processing service…' (+285) landed eight days before any CI check existed.

strengths: Test, build and staging deploy all automated

executive_summary: In the 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-21 sprint Team_Epsilon shipped a payments service with signed webhooks, refunds, unit tests, documentation and a CI/CD pipeline (8 commits, +1,120/-12; 16/21 points Done). Almost all of it is Liam's: he authored 6 of 8 commits and every ticket, while Maya and Noah made one trivial commit each. Peer ratings average 2.0/5, reflecting freeriding and no PR or stand-up communication.
strengths: Automated test, build and staging deploy
weaknesses: One member carried the whole sprint
key_recommendations: Assign every member tickets at sprint planning and track them on the board.
Require PRs with at least one reviewer instead of pushing to main.
Add refund tests and set up CI at the start of each sprint.
Pair Maya and Noah with Liam to spread knowledge of the payments code.
